detaileddescription.para: Implements GPUErrorHandler interface for unified error classification, logging, and recovery policy application across CUDA and HIP backends.

listitem.para: Thread-safe: internal mutex protects error handler state
Error mapping: comprehensive CUDA/HIP error code taxonomy
Logging: all errors logged via spdlog with context
Policy application: default policies per error class (configurable)
Exception safety: noexcept where possible; documented contract
